To be more specific, the woman was inside the main office of the Burning Red Pavilion, tormenting the poor manager of the
establishment.
"Who do you think you are to deny donations to our holy church? You damned infidel! Do you think you won't burn in the fires of eternal damnation?" The old woman yelled, pounding the table violently.
Although she looked frail, she was a seventh-ring mage, equivalent to the Enlightened Soul Realm, and was much stronger than most of the guards in that place.
"Please, ma'am, I just ask for calm. Miss Meilin is the only one who can grant such things! The manager said, sweating nervously.
He had already received the message that Meilin was alive and would be back soon, but damn it, couldn't she be a little faster?
"B-but I can offer you a loan at a very friendly interest rate!" The manager suddenly suggested. "One million superior Qi crystals at a rate of-"
Before he could even finish speaking, the sacred book carried by the old woman hit him in the face with a bang.
The mere suggestion of a loan instead of a donation made the old woman even more enraged.
Her angry screams echoed throughout the Burning Red Pavilion, causing the attendants in the main hall to look up with concern.
Their manager wasn't going to be killed by that damn old woman, was he?
Although it looked small, that book was filled with metal and weighed over two kilograms, enough to kill a mortal if thrown hard enough.
Fortunately, the manager had some level of cultivation and only got up with a bloody nose.
Regaining his composure and wiping the blood from his face, he prepared to respond politely.
Fortunately, she had already left, muttering angry words along the
way.
That had been his routine for the past few months. Every single day, religiously, that old woman came to disturb him.
Making his life miserable seemed to be her therapy.
In the end, the manager just grunted, ready to return to the peace of his documents.
However, the moment he sat down, he was forced to get up again.
A crash echoed through the skies and a commotion began outside.
With quick steps, he left his office and ran to the courtyard, looking up.
There, he saw a huge, luxurious flying ship tearing through the clouds.
The flying vessel hovered over Eagle Peak Valley for a brief moment before disappearing, revealing three figures.
One of these figures headed toward the city lord's mansion, while the other two descended toward the Pavilion.
The moment he recognized those people, the manager bowed respectfully.
"This lowly one greets young miss Jin Meilin and young master Long Qingyi!" He shouted, his heart leaping with joy.
Finally, his suffering was over!

Jin Meilin looked at her subordinate's face for a brief moment before letting out a sweet, soft laugh, her delicate fingers flowing to her lips. "What happened to your face?" she asked, looking at the book-shaped mark on the man's fair skin.

making way for Meilin.
Obviously, the first thing they went to check were the vaults.
The pavilion had two in total: a fake vault in the basement and a real one that used special spiritual distortion formations, capable of storing absurd amounts of resources.
Even so, the place was already reaching its limit, filled with piles and piles of treasures, artifacts, jewels, and Qi crystals, more than they
could count.
These were the gains from the last few months of trade at the Burning Red Pavilion.

The Third prince's victory had brought considerable stability to the kingdom, even if only temporarily and the money injected by many nobles and the plans for reconstruction were making the trade routes flourish even more.

Even the export routes for goods were booming with prosperity, although no new ones had been opened since Meilin's departure. "Has the king already paid the first installment of his loan?" Meilin asked, calculating the amount of wealth there with just her eyes.
"No, young lady, but I'm about to start collecting!"
"Don't worry, he'll start paying soon." Meilin gave a soft smile.
She was quite impressed with herself.
Her current wealth was probably not much less than what she had when she was the manager of the Blue Sea Kingdom branch of the
Five Colors Pavilion.
No, in fact, she was even richer.
In the end, even though she had complete control over the money from the old branch, that amount still belonged to her father.
This wealth here belonged to no one but her, her husband, and of course, his other wives who had helped her build it all.
With a satisfied sigh, she left the vault with Qingyi and the manager, asking for a little privacy.
Soon, the couple found themselves alone in the private garden of the
huge main building of the fiery red pavilion, enjoying each other's
warmth.
"We're back... what shall we do now?" she asked.
"I don't know." Qingyi shook his head. "I was thinking of going to the Western Continent, or maybe the Illuminated Sky Empire. My cultivation is stable, but I want to test my limits."
"Hm..." Meilin exhaled, turning her gaze to the horizon as she noticed
a figure approaching.
It was Margareth, who had gone to the lord's mansion just to pick up
some personal belongings.
She seemed hurried, landing beside them.
"Husband... while I was away, an important letter arrived for me. It's
from the Kingdom of Valemont, regarding Isabel's family." Margareth said, handing the envelope to Qingyi.
The moment the handsome young man read the contents, his heart
sank.
Apparently, the Western Continent was indeed his next goal.

Still, none of them backed down.
Immediately, the queen walked to the front of the gates leading to the powerful and luxurious fortress that had guarded her family for many years.
Behind her were the two hundred guards with weapons in hand.
She could feel that powerful aura approaching, the sounds of blades clashing and the cries of pain and despair.
It was close.

Above this human wall stood a man with piercing blue eyes and
golden hair. He stared coldly at the queen, his eyes roaming over her voluptuous, mature curves.
"Sofia, my queen... as beautiful as ever. Make way and let me pass; I promise I will give you a dignified life by my side."
Sofia's face twisted in disgust as she reached out her hand.
Her eyes flashed and the air around her became violent, her mana spreading and forming exactly a thousand blades of wind behind her.
She pointed a single finger toward Count Nirm and his men, then unleashed the attack.

His powerful muscles burned beneath his armor as mana coursed
through his body.

warriors.

there was one fundamental difference.
The way that power was employed.
Mages were external channelers. They could strengthen their bodies, but often only used complex mathematical formulas to transform mana into spells.
Warriors, on the other hand, channeled mana into their own bodies,
strengthening themselves and using it in a similar way to what Eastern cultivators did.
This was what they called aura, and although it was treated
differently from the mana of mages, it was, in the end, the same thing.

More than ten impenetrable barriers rose from the ground in front of
her as Nirm approached.
He didn't seem willing to stop, and he didn't.
His body crashed through the first barrier with a bang, his sword
cutting through the second and third before breaking the fourth with
a kick.
Sofia's whole body trembled, a trickle of blood running down her lips
as Nirm approached.

The air around her exploded in a shockwave.
Her dress fluttered and she covered her face, retreating to her
soldiers as a crater swallowed dozens of meters around her.

the air, hitting a wall over twenty meters thick of solid concrete, one

From the depths of the now completely cracked concrete monument, Nirm emerged, spitting blood on the ground.

paragraphs: "Tell me your name, boy," Nirm demanded.
He stopped climbing, hovering a few hundred meters above the capital. The look of hatred on his face was replaced by a gentle smile.
That altitude was not enough to prevent the death of everyone below during combat, but he didn't care.
"Long Qingyi," the handsome young man replied.
His answer was brief, but his voice was soon filled with mockery.
"Tell me, little cuckold, what makes you raise a blade against my wife's family? Is it the one my wife calls Belcuckold?"
"Little cuckold? Belcuckold?" Nirm's smile disappeared, anger returning with full force.
"I'll bring your tongue and that cheeky little girl's to Lord Belgrath on a platter!"
The moment Nirm's voice fell silent, he lunged forward. His sword tore through the air, creating a terrifying pressure toward Qingyi.
Qingyi raised the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword and parried Nirm's blade with a smooth movement.
A metallic clang echoed, immediately followed by a powerful shockwave that engulfed the two.
Nirm froze in midair. A shower of sparks filled his vision as the steel of his weapon pressed against Qingyi's blade.
His muscles burned as he put every ounce of his physical strength into pressing against the young man.
Still, nothing changed.
The handsome young man remained completely unmoved. He didn't
even hold his sword with both hands; he just kept his right arm extended, casually holding the hilt.
"You're disappointing me, old man. Put everything you've got into it or die." Qingyi spoke indifferently.
With a simple movement, he threw Nirm backward.
Honestly, Nirm was powerful. Qingyi could tell that his current strength was comparable to the peak of the True Immortal Realm.
But even that wasn't enough.
Qingyi's journey to that land had lasted more than a month. In that time, he had reached the peak of the False Immortal Realm, increasing his power dramatically.
Added to the fact that Nirm had no special lineage or constitution, they were simply on incomparable levels.
Of course, Qingyi did not look down on Nirm too much.
Although the people of the west had no lineages or constitutions,
they still had a way to increase their power tremendously: the quality and element of their Mana Heart.
Nirm had not yet resorted to either.
Qingyi's momentum sent Nirm flying, his body only coming to a stop after fifty meters. His face regained some calm, and his eyes analyzed Qingyi coldly.
He could no longer take this battle lightly. He had already understood that Qingyi was an enemy capable of killing him with a single wrong
move.
Nirm closed his eyes and reached into the depths of his being.
Then, he released his elemental mana.
His body was engulfed in a crimson energy, even deeper than before. His torn muscles regenerated with maximum power, bulging beneath the steel of his armor.
His aura expanded, dominating everything within a ten-meter radius, and every drop of water in the air around him evaporated instantly.
Taking a single moment to prepare, Nirm lunged toward Qingyi. A cone of crimson flames formed in front of his blade, his entire body spinning like a living hurricane.
"YOU WILL PAY FOR THIS DISRESPECT, BRAT!" Nirm roared.
Qingyi simply watched the attack approach, studying the technique with curiosity before smiling.
"Very well, I won't hold back either," the handsome young man said.
He pointed his weapon at the approaching enemy and lunged. His blade tore through the air with terrifying speed, enveloped in a thick, thunderous veil.
Below, Sofia covered her body and her daughter's with a powerful green barrier, closing her eyes as the two techniques collided in the
skies.
For a brief moment, there was silence.
Then, the explosion came.
Hundreds of meters were consumed by a sea of crimson flames and lightning. Dozens of kilometers were swept away by shock waves, and
terrible tremors shook the entire capital.
"I-impossible..."
Nirm's voice echoed, weak and trembling.
The flames and lightning surrounding them slowly disappeared, leaving nothing but a hot black mist, which was soon dispersed by the
wind.
The melted tip of Nirm's sword fell to the ground. He looked down, seeing Qingyi's blade piercing his chest and destroying his mana
heart.
"Guhlk!"
Blood rose in Nirm's throat as Qingyi pulled out the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, wiping the blood from the metal with a quick,
smooth slashing motion.
"L-Lord Belgarath will not forgive you, he-"
Nirm's words were suddenly cut off. Qingyi's sword ripped through
his throat, sending his head flying into the sky.
Qingyi ignored the falling body, turning his gaze to the soldiers below.
There were still about eight thousand rebels. Some were already
beginning to retreat as they realized their leader was dead.
The handsome young man raised a single finger. Exactly one hundred ethereal, thunderous swords appeared around his body.
He pointed his finger toward the army and unleashed the attack.
The swords exploded at a terrifying speed, falling upon those soldiers unable to defend themselves.

He had trained that technique extensively in the Mind World. Now, he barely needed to pay attention to use it, just spreading thin threads of Qi and cutting through everything he sensed in front of him.
With a sigh, Qingyi descended from the skies, landing beside Sofia
and Isabel.
The queen was trembling, while Isabel's eyes shone brightly.
"Oh... did you see that, mom? Isn't my hubby amazing? That damn Belcuckold won't stand a chance against him! Hehehe~~"
Isabel giggled, her huge breasts bouncing as she ran towards Qingyi, hugging him tightly.
Qingyi just smiled and shook his head. He looked at Sofia, bowing
gently.
"Long Qingyi greets his mother-in-law. I apologize for having to meet
in such a sudden and inappropriate manner..."
"D-don't worry," Sofia said, her voice trembling. She looked at her men, strengthening her own heart.
"Open the castle gates and clean up the trash left in the city! Our
savior should not feel unwelcome!"
Her family was not finished. Not yet...
Whether Qingyi was good for her daughter or not, she would soon
find out.

paragraphs: "Where is Nirm? He took my men and promised me victory, but I see no victory beneath my feet."
Lord Belgrath's voice echoed, low, hoarse, and angry.
He sat on his throne inside the most powerful fortress in the far north, guarded by more than twenty thousand soldiers.
Its pure white walls stretched for dozens of kilometers, protecting the only valley that gave the Green Skins unrestricted access to the kingdom of Valemont.
He did not plan to attack the royal capital yet, not without a complete and absolute guarantee of victory.
He would not bet everything on them being able to break through the walls quickly. He wanted to be prepared for both a quick battle and a slow and drawn-out war.

"He is dead, my lord. Nirm was able to break through the walls, but at the last moment, a young talent seems to have appeared and defeated him, using a strange energy to almost completely exterminate his army..."
Belgrath's fingers struck the armrest of his throne with a loud crack, his teeth clenching in a deep frown.
"And?" Belgrath spoke, making the messenger below him tremble.
"David Valemont also seems to have awakened and is regenerating at a frightening speed. In just a few months, he should reach full strength.
The young man who defeated Nirm has been declared prince, given full control of the royal armies, and his marriage to Isabel has been set for shortly after the end of the civil war."
The messenger trembled again, lowering his head and waiting for an
explosion of rage.
But all he heard was an angry grunt.
Belgrath stood up, walking across the dark throne room, all its windows sealed with concrete.
He still had the ancient texts, scrolls that spoke of when his family was the true ruler of this land, of when that throne room, before it was sealed, was the heart of power in the region.
He had already broken down the gates leading to it, but it was still far from being a place where one could be crowned king.
"David is recovering and has found a powerful specialist to marry that damn brat... what difference does that make?"

More than fifty thousand green-skinned, red-eyed monsters marched. The shortest was over two meters tall, with protruding teeth and primitive armors.
They all marched toward him, led by a figure whose power was so profound that Belgrath himself could barely sense it.
Belgrath swallowed hard and, with a smooth movement, jumped onto the walls of his fortress.
He calmed his men and smiled at the leader of that monstrous army.
If he led such powerful soldiers, what opponent could defeat him?
Even all of David's armies would be like wheat, ready to be harvested by Belgrath's forces.

The creature was also excited about this alliance.

He purged corrupt nobles, punished those who fled, and even gave a list of names to his son-in-law, Qingyi.

In the end, the young man was testing the power of the warriors on the western continent and, as a bonus, was helping his wife's family by exterminating corrupt pigs.
"Y-Your Highness, please! Hear me out! I didn't run away, I just="
Before the corrupt nobleman could even finish his sentence, his head
flew into the sky.
"What a disappointment..." Qingyi grunted, watching his men storm the mansion.
Honestly, those nobles were quite lucky.
Their families were spared, and only a portion of their wealth was confiscated, with all assets outside the capital remaining completely untouched.
He didn't know if, on the eastern continent, the monarchs would be
so merciful.
"Your Highness."
A voice echoed from behind Qingyi, who turned around to see a
figure approaching.
It was an ordinary-looking woman clad in steel armor, her face carrying a hint of discontent as she knelt down.

escape with Qingyi had really brought her a lot of headaches and
countless sleepless nights.
Now that Qingyi was a prince, the woman couldn't even show her discontent. Not that she had the courage to do so before, considering the boy's current power alone.

expert.

"Yes, my prince."

men.

into Qingyi's arms, her face lit up with an excited look.

Without giving Qingyi time to respond, David turned, facing the officers at the front of the army.
"Belgrath is marching towards us!
He has betrayed humanity and allied himself with orc pigs!
We will kill him and scatter his guts across the capital!
We will wash away this shame from our people!"
David roared, answered by a powerful battle cry.
"Prepare to march," David ordered his officers before beckoning Qingyi to follow him.
"Ugh... it sounds disgusting," Ruxue's sweet, mature voice echoed in Qingyi's mind.
"It is disgusting," Qingyi shook his head.
Well, he had always wanted to kill orcs.
Unfortunately, there were no orcs on Earth, and even if there were, he would not have had the power to do so at that time.
Fortunately, the same was not true for this world.
With a sigh, he followed David silently.
The rest of the preparations did not take long, and soon, he had to leave with the army, flying a few hundred meters above the ground.
He was a little apprehensive about leaving Isabel in the capital, but she needed some time with her mother.
Besides, she was not really at risk, as Qingyi had given her a pendant with defensive arrays, capable of teleporting her directly to the world of the mind if she were in danger.
Following Qingyi and organizing the marching armies were his officers, David Valemont's trusted men, about fifty of them.
Only one was flying alongside Qingyi.
He was a general who had only recently reached the ninth ring and who would replace the last guardian of the kingdom, killed by
Belgrath in an ambush.
He was a tall, honest, and quiet man with short black hair, blue eyes,
and fair skin.
"How far are we from Belgrath's forces?" Qingyi asked, turning his
face to the general.
"No more than two weeks, Your Highness.
Belgrath set out many days
ago, and orcs are fast."
"Hmm...
I don't think they're very interested in ambushes, are they?"
"No, Your Highness.
Orcs don't ambush, they just attack head-on," the
general shook his head.
"Good..." Qingyi flashed a big smile.
And so, the journey continued.
They passed through large forests and lush groves, full of mana
beasts.
They were different creatures from the ones Qingyi used to encounter on the eastern continent, though very similar.
Only after about twelve days of travel did the army stop.
They were on the edge of a large canyon in a desert region in the center of the kingdom.
That was the fastest passage Belgrath could use to reach the capital.
Since he was accompanied by an orc army, Qingyi's officers stated
that Belgrath would likely follow that route.
So, the army began to organize.
They surrounded the passage of just over two kilometers, setting up defensive barricades and preparing the camp.
Qingyi stayed in the central tent, sitting at the end of a huge wooden table, with his officers surrounding him.
Honestly, it still felt a little strange for him to be in that position.
He had seen the third prince and current king of the Blue Sea Kingdom in it.
He had seen his wife, Tang Biyue, in it.
But this was the first time he himself was there, surrounded by competent officers who took his words as law.
At the center of it all was a huge map of the kingdom.
It was already marked with the positions from the latest reports Qingyi had received from the escorts he had sent north.
Qingyi stood up, observing the markings carefully.
Belgrath's armies should be no more than a hundred kilometers away.
At the orcs' marching speed, it shouldn't take them more than a day
to get there.
Qingyi's lips parted, ready to say something.
But before he could, his
body froze.
A powerful murderous intent fell upon his entire army and his lips
parted in a broad smile.
The enemy was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - Weakling
paragraphs: "You humans and your puny tactics are of no interest to my people," declared the leader of the orc army.
He was a rising lord among his people, and although he was not a young talent, he had found an incomparable treasure many years ago.
This treasure granted him power and a little wisdom, just enough to put him above his peers.
As soon as he learned how to use the artifact, he began his path to becoming an absolute power, aiming to be the monarch of all greenskins.

Unfortunately, his peers noticed this rise and did everything they could to block his path, killing his people and ambushing his soldiers. After all, the orc people were not the only ones among the greenskins. Fortunately, Belgrath had given him a great opportunity outside his homeland, the chance to have a safe place to increase his troops.
One day, when he had enough troops, he would finally be able to return to the swamps of the greenskins.
"I understand your concerns, Lord Zharuk, but please, going head-to-head against the royal army is not a good idea. We don't even know how powerful that brat who killed Count Nirm is."
"Stay here, keep crying. My soldiers are marching! Today, we eat man meat!" Zharuk roared. His more than thirty thousand orcs marched side by side with Belgrath's soldiers.
The moment his voice fell silent, the humans trembled while the orcs vibrated.
Shouts full of amusement and hatred filled their ranks, their rusty weapons raised to the heavens.
Without waiting, Zharuk took the lead, entering the Kanyon.
Belgrath could only sigh, following alongside Zharuk, the two ascending into the skies.
He could already see that the royal armies were ready. Above the Kanyon, he saw two figures rising into the skies.
"Take care of the soldiers below, I'll deal with these two." Qingyi ordered the general at his side, watching Belgrath and Zharuk approach, followed by the orcs and, close behind, the human armies.
Honestly, Zharuk was exactly as Qingyi had imagined.
Dressed in leather with steel plates, he carried a huge axe, yellowed, protruding teeth marking his flat, greenish face.
His muscular body stood over three meters tall and his muscle density and physical power were not inferior to those of a low-blooded dragon-man.

"You must be Lord Belcuckold, my wife has spoken highly of you. Is your son well? I hope he doesn't have any problems because he has a castrated father too, hahaha." Qingyi laughed loudly at Belgrath, who had just arrived thirty meters away.
"You... damn bastard!" Belgrath's face immediately contorted, his teeth clenched in pure rage.
"Know that after crippling you, I will hand that insolent bitch over to the orcs. Let's see if you can still keep that smile then!"
That, in fact, wiped the smile off Qingyi's face, who turned toward the Orc Lord.

"I've heard that your people are honest and honorable. I don't believe you'll interfere in a battle between me and Belgrath, am I correct?" Qingyi asked, eliciting a huge smile from Zharuk's ugly face.
"I like you, hahahaha. Kill him, I don't care. When you're done, we'll fight."
"Good." Qingyi smiled, even more so when he realized that Belgrath's face showed no fear.
Qingyi would make him see despair.
From behind the beautiful young man, the enormous figure of a black dragon appeared, hovering over the army below him.
Its roar spread for miles, its frightening figure taking the courage out of anyone there.
Belgrath realized his mistake and tried to react, but it was already too late.
Qingyi was already upon him, swinging the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword. He used his draconic vision to find the location of Belgrath's mana heart.
With a smooth movement, before Belgrath could even defend himself, Qingyi pierced his mana heart. At the same time, he created a small ball of Qi in his free hand, aiming it toward Belgrath's balls.
A heart-wrenching scream echoed as Belgrath was thrown towards
his troops.
His balls were obliterated as his face filled with tears, a trail of blood
following his body.
Had he been defeated? So weakly and pathetically?
Why? How was that possible? Was this truly the end of his dream?
No, impossible!

Belgrath denied it with all his might. But in the end, he could not change anything as he was grabbed by one of his officers. "Hahahaha, you're good for an insignificant human." Zharuk sniffed the air. "You don't even smell like an puny human, huh? Hahahaha." Zharuk's laughter echoed throughout the Kanyon, mingling with the cries of pain and rage as his orcs clashed with Qingyi's soldiers. He hardly seemed to notice his ally's defeat, and honestly, he didn't really care.
He was, after all, an orc. His intelligence was limited, and violence was the basis of his life.
Qingyi simply returned Zharuk's smile, not even bothering to taunt
him.
He doubted Zharuk was intelligent enough to understand any kind of
taunt he might be inclined to offer.
Any kind, except one, of course.
"Just come on already, weakling, I don't have all day." Qingyi smiled, his voice full of mockery.
"Weakling? Me? YOU ARE WEAKLING!" Zharuk roared, swinging his huge axe. The positive impression he had had of Qingyi vanished immediately.
'Strong... Qingyi said mentally as he parried Zharuk's axe blade. The orc didn't hold back, surrounding his weapon with powerful flaming
mana.
The moment the blade and the Sky-Defying Thunder Sword collided,
a ball of fire engulfed them both. The air around them boiled and even some poor birds flying on the horizon were instantly charred as the fire rose into the sky.
To the Orc Lord's surprise, Qingyi didn't even flinch, only shuddering slightly, displaying a confident smile.
"Well... if it weren't for my bloodline projection, you would have hurt me badly, weakling." Qingyi smiled, landing a kick on Zharuk's chest and spinning in the air.
If Qingyi hadn't advanced his lineage earlier, Zharuk would have given
him quite a headache.
Fortunately, he had improved greatly and now barely felt any pressure from that Orc Lord.
"Ugh..." Zharuk was thrown back many meters. His face filled with rage
as he brought his hand to his chest, removing a small item.
A golden talisman, the kind Qingyi knew well.
That young hero of the Church of Auranys, whom he had met a few
months ago in Eagle Peak Valley, had one identical to this. Why on earth did Zharuk have something like this with him?

chapters.title: Chapter 415 DIE!
paragraphs: Zharuk gripped the pendant tightly and squeezed it, a golden light immediately engulfing his huge body.

These days, any divine artifact from Auranys would consider beings like orcs to be beasts of darkness, exploding them during use; an effect imbued on them after a bloody war many hundreds of millennia ago.
The fact that this artifact hadn't exploded Zharuk immediately made it clear that the item was at least a hundred thousand years old.
Qingyi took a single step back in the air, watching the golden light spread across Zharuk's body.
The orc's veins glowed and his blood-red eyes were filled with gold, even the reddish flames surrounding his axe changing.
That was dangerous.
"You... weakling... DIE!" Zharuk roared, striking with his axe with full force.
That finally drew a serious reaction from Qingyi, who covered his body with black scales, using the first form of the Storm Monarch Sword Art.
In front of the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, the huge, sharp tip of an ethereal blade appeared, stretching almost five meters above Qingyi, powerful lightning bolts engulfing everything around him.
With a single moment to prepare, he attacked, his face carrying more curiosity than concern as his Heaven-defying Thunder Sword and Zharuk's Golden Flame Axe collided.
In the next moment, the world froze.
Below, the True Immortal who was massacring the orc troops raised a single glance, immediately being blinded by the flash of light, the world divided between the orc's gold and Qingyi's lightning.

This stalemate lasted a single moment before the attack of both collapsed under each other, meeting in the center and then spreading out to all sides, a breath of lightning and flames flowing towards the army on the ground.
"Fall back, now!" The general roared at the royal troops, who, engaged with the orcs, were barely able to react.
Fortunately, they managed to retreat sufficiently for the effects of the clash to fall only on the orcs, whose combat power was already limited by Qingyi's lineage projection.
A deluge of flames and lightning fell into the center of the enemy ranks and exploded, opening a fiery tear in the ground and, in a single moment, killing hundreds of orcs.
Qingyi gritted his teeth, a thin trickle of blood leaving his lips as he punched, passing through Zharuk's blade and hitting his ugly face.
A pained grunt escaped the Orc Warlord's lips, his body being catapulted backwards like a cannonball.
Qingyi's punch created a powerful shockwave, accompanied by another wave as Zharuk broke the speed of sound.
Belgrath's officers, who were still trying to keep their army in line, preparing to fight after the orcs, could only watch in terror as the huge body of almost a ton of pure muscle flew towards them.
They tried to take cover and separate, but it was too late, the body of the orc leader landing on the compact columns with a devastating thud.
He sank dozens of meters into the ground, raising a cloud of dust, soldiers hundreds of meters away being thrown into the air as the ground beneath their feet turned to nothing but dust.
"Ugh... Damn weakling... Zharuk will..." Zharuk had barely finished his sentence when a flaming spear hit his chest with a powerful thud, stunning him again.
He tried to get up, but was soon hit by a second spear and then a third, fourth and fifth.
From the sixth spear onwards, Zharuk's body began to sink into the ground, descending dozens of meters with each spear, the smell of burnt putrid flesh rising from the huge crater engulfed in flames.
Qingyi showed no mercy, raising his hand and calling for the ninth and final spear of the Art of the Nine Spears of Celestial Fire, his body engulfed in fiery, powerful flames.
He took a single moment to think before finally attacking.
The moment the spear left his grasp, his body was thrown backwards with the rebound, a shockwave rising from his fingers and spreading with a mighty crash.
The fire followed the spear like the wings of a phoenix, landing over the crater.
Qingyi's clothes fluttered, his black hair; which had been carefully pinned up by the girls in the World of Mind before he left; escaped, swinging violently as the gust of hot air hit his face.
The brightness of that explosion illuminated more intensely than the sun in the sky.
Qingyi just watched coldly as the heat ceased and, little by little, the black smoke dispersed into the air, revealing Zharuk's body.
He was naturally not in a good state, but to Qingyi's surprise, he was
still alive.
His bones were visible and even his lungs, struggling for air; every organ in his body collapsed, every inch of his skin charred.
Still, he struggled on, chanting strange names, his once golden eyes now glowing with a deep darkness.
Qingyi had heard of it; orcs had their own gods.
Their names weren't known to most, but Qingyi knew they were
powerful and one of the main reasons for the orcs' fighting power.
If he had time, Zharuk could recover with even more power and once
again try to defeat Qingyi.
Unfortunately for him, the handsome young man had already decided the end of that battle.
Zharuk's attack had caused him some internal damage, but this had already been healed by the Seed of Life.
What really worried him was that his men were still having trouble
with the orcs.
Despite the short time Qingyi had led them, they were his
subordinates and respected him deeply.
With a sigh, Qingyi just stepped on Zharuk's head and smashed it, destroying his brain and imbuing his feet with lightning, ensuring that the entire inside of Zharuk's body was completely destroyed,
reducing him to nothing but bloody goo.
Qingyi just shook his head.
Raising a single hand, the only thing intact on Zharuk's body, the
talisman he had used to gain all this power, flew into his grasp. Qingyi was about to observe it more carefully when something broke through the air, flying towards his back and through his chest.
It was a spear, powerful and strangely stealthy, carrying the power of
a True Immortal.
"Uh... what an interesting little thing." Qingyi smiled, turning around.

chapters.title: Chapter 416 Golden Convergence Pendant
paragraphs: The Belgrath's official who had thrown the spear at Qingyi shuddered.
He was an expert of the eighth ring, equivalent to a False Immortal, and an extremely powerful individual with great chances of reaching the ninth ring.
Being one of Belgrath's favorite officials, he had received a magic scroll carrying that spear, imbued with one of his leader's strongest attacks and surrounded by stealth arrays.
He had aimed exactly where Qingyi's mana heart should have been, going into ecstasy when he realized that his attack had worked.
However, that ecstasy soon turned to sheer terror as Qingyi casually pulled the spear from his chest, throwing it to the ground.
The dread intensified as the hole created by the attack closed immediately, even the internal wounds healing in an instant.
"You're very courageous. Unfortunately, courage without power is worth as much as a brain without a body." Qingyi smiled.
The officer tried to retreat, but it was too late.
Qingyi was already upon him, swinging his hand in a gentle slap. With a single movement, the officer's head exploded like a watermelon, his decapitated body falling to the ground.
Qingyi took a step towards the surviving Belgrath soldiers surrounding him.
They immediately retreated, running in all directions, the main guard escorting Belgrath already many kilometers away.
Qingyi considered chasing them, but in the end just shook his head, focusing his gaze on the battle between the royal forces and the orcs.
The green skins hadn't even noticed the death of their leader and were still fighting voraciously.
They had already killed more than two thousand royal soldiers.

Although the green skins had suffered more casualties, this was only because they had been the biggest victims of the clash between Qingyi and Zharuk; now, they were beginning to turn the tide of the battle.
With one smooth movement, Qingyi activated the fourth form of the Tempest Monarch Sword Art.
Blades began to appear around him: dozens, hundreds, thousands. The number grew until he decided it was enough and let them fall on the orcs.
Like rain, the steel came down, cutting through skin, bone, fat, flesh and muscle.
Horrific sounds filled the battlefield as the entire orc front line collapsed immediately.
But it didn't stop there.
Qingyi's blades changed direction, spinning in the air before flying into the rear lines, continuing to cut without stopping.
The ground was bathed in blood, the screams of pain and despair falling on deaf ears under Qingyi's cold gaze.
With a sigh, he shook his head, keeping Draconic Qi in his brain and eyes as he analyzed the golden artifact in his hands.
It was a circular golden pendant, adorned with a thin silver cord.
Its center bore the figure of a smiling woman's face, slightly worn by time, its shape barely distinguishable.
Although it looked complete in a way, the pendant still had small fittings on its sides, as if it were just a fragment of a whole.
[Name: Golden Convergence Pendant
Description: An item created in an ancient forge many millennia ago, by the hands of the most talented craftsman of his time.
One of five items made in honor of the Goddess of Light and Justice, Auranys, created to rally heroes and defeat an ancient evil.
Presenting it to the Divine Church of Auranys will have you declared a hero of a generation. It can grant power to any wearer, even if not accepted by the pendant yet.
Grade: Astral]
The moment he saw that description, Qingyi's eyes shone deeply.
So that was where Zharuk's power came from and, above all, that was the item that made Lucien a chosen hero.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - You did this to yourself
paragraphs: It was a gloomy morning at the Belgrath family stronghold.
Once guarded by an army of over ten thousand mighty soldiers, now it barely held a hundred defenders scattered across its walls.
They were the only ones who had chosen to remain at their lord's side until the end.
There were others, of course, but they were responsible for escorting the duke's family to the Rose Empire; a long and dangerous journey.
"Sir, something is approaching..." A worried voice echoed from one of the younger defenders to the captain of the guard, a powerful warrior of the eighth ring.
The captain narrowed his eyes, imbuing mana into his pupils and looking beyond the fog that surrounded the fortress.
He could clearly see hundreds of shadows approaching. These shadows soon turned into thousands, and then tens of thousands.
The time had come. They were surrounded.
The captain gritted his teeth, his eyes flashing with fury as he prepared to activate the fortress's defensive arrays, powerful enough that its walls could hold off ninth ring mages.
"I am two hundred years old," the captain said.

"I have protected the Belgrath family all my life, as did my father, my father's father, and his father before him, for over a thousand years, since they were the rightful rulers of this land. We have never failed!"
The captain grabbed a small talisman, ready to crush it in his hands and activate the formation.
"And that won't-..." The captain's words were suddenly cut off, the eyes of the young soldier beside him widening in terror.
He could see, for a brief moment, an ethereal, thunderous flying
blade, a mere blur tearing through the air at absurd speed and passing through the captain's throat.
In a single moment, the old warrior's head was sent flying into the air with a gush of blood from his decapitated neck, his eyes filled with shock, still unable to comprehend that he had died.
The captain's body fell to the ground, seized by terrible spasms.
"Shit, get the talisman, activate the formations!" Another soldier roared, and the young man tried to act, but it was already too late.
Countless sharp whistles tore through the air, each carrying a soldier with it.
Even those who tried to hide behind the concrete walls were killed instantly, the flying blades cutting through the concrete as if it were butter.
"Your Highness is truly efficient at killing, I would never be able to eliminate them so cleanly..." The general beside Qingyi spoke, eliciting a soft laugh from the young man.
"My land is not very kind to those who are not good at killing; the strong are even more lawless than here," Qingyi replied, flying above the wall.
His eyes stared coldly at the corpses in the fortress before finally focusing on the main building.
"Order the soldiers to secure the fortress and protect the walls, I will take care of Belgrath," Qingyi commanded.
"Yes, Your Highness." The general bowed respectfully before leaving, shouting orders to his men.
Silently, Qingyi approached the main building, moving his face briefly before entering it, observing the world beyond the walls of that fortress.
That was the land from which this fortress protected the kingdom; putrid swamps filled with beasts and death, creatures born for
violence.
He was curious about what lay within, but now was simply not the time.
With a sigh, Qingyi finally entered the main building, his eyes immediately widening.
He curved his body and moved his hands forward, a powerful rumble echoing as his fingers closed around a black spear.
The ground beneath his feet gave way, the concrete cracking as he took a single step back.
The spear began to spin in his grip, struggling to pierce his heart.
Despite its power, Qingyi did not yield, even when the steel of the spear turned the palm of his hand into raw flesh, soaking it with his blood.
With a smooth motion, Qingyi clenched his fists, breaking the spear in two and throwing it to the ground.
"This was your plan? Quite disappointing." Qingyi laughed, lifting his face to a dying figure on an ancient throne.
The figure's eyes were downcast and his lips curved into a soft smile.
Approaching, Qingyi clenched his hands, feeling the pain in his palms go away as the Seed of Life worked, healing him instantly.
"Ah... Hahaha." A bitter laugh escaped Belgrath's lips. "It took a lot of work to activate this array without my mana heart. You really ruined
me, young man."
"You did this to yourself," Qingyi shook his head. "First, when you tried to marry your son to my Isabel. Second, when you tried to steal the crown from my father-in-law, David Valemont.
"S-steal? Hahaha." Belgrath raised his torso with difficulty, leaning on the throne, his voice coming out like the roar of a beast.
"I cannot steal what is rightfully mine, I can only reclaim what is
rightfully mine... The Valemont family are the thieves!"
Belgrath returned to his throne, coughing up blood.
"It doesn't matter," Qingyi shook his head, drawing the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
"In the end, you raised your weapon against my wife's family, and you
are left with nothing but death."
With a smooth movement, he beheaded Belgrath and then threw the
body into the Mind World, instructing Ruxue to deliver it to
Khaedryss.
She would probably make a great feast out of that corpse.

With a sigh, Qingyi stored the head in the Mind World, leaving Belgrath's throne room and walking to the courtyard of the fortress. His men had already taken over the fortress and assumed defensive positions on the wall.
"Your Highness... Is it done? Where is Belgrath?" The general asked, kneeling in front of Qingyi.
"Dead. I will only take his head to my father-in-law." Qingyi shook his
head.
"Make sure the fortress has enough supplies and men to defend against the invaders from the north, and then march with the rest of
the troops. I will go ahead."
The general opened his lips to question, but in the end, he remained
silent.
He was a warrior of the ninth ring, equivalent to a True Immortal. He should be able to handle those things on his own.
With nothing else to do, Qingyi simply left, flying toward the capital of the kingdom of Valemont.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - Are these three heroines beauties?
paragraphs: In the capital, things couldn't be livelier.
David Valemont had recovered considerably. Now able to use his mana, he made a grand public appearance and delivered a powerful speech.

In this speech, he not only announced Qingyi's victory over Belgrath's forces and the fact that he was already marching toward the fortress in the far north, but also decreed a large temporary reduction in taxes.
The latter announcement was especially important to the merchants of the capital, who were still trying to recover after months of siege.
Naturally, all these proclamations were met with great celebrations by the population.
At that very moment, David Valemont was relaxing in one of his many private gardens in his luxurious palace, savoring a sip of wine.
How could he not be happy?
His daughter had found a good and powerful man, someone willing to get his hands dirty to help his wife's family and who, apparently, would die for Isabel.
David took another sip of wine before finally standing up, sighing heavily and looking up at the skies.
He could see a youthful figure approaching on the horizon, with a powerful body and a handsome face that wore a big smile.
"Son-in-law, why are you back so soon? Where is the army?" David asked, a little confused.
"I decided to come ahead," Qingyi nodded, opening his space ring and removing Belgrath's head, still drenched in blood.
"I handed over control of the army to your trusted men. They should
come soon after garrisoning Belgrath's fortress," Qingyi said, throwing the head at David's feet.
"Uh..." David crouched down, picking up Belgrath's head and staring at it for a moment before smiling.
He enveloped it with mana, turning it into dust.
"I believe you didn't give his body a proper burial?" David asked.
"No, I left it to be devoured by beasts." Qingyi shook his head, eliciting a laugh from David.
The laughter soon ceased, replaced by a serious and melancholic voice.
"Very well, Son-in-law. You saved me and my Sofia from perdition. You even brought my little Isabel to me. My gratitude is eternal and endless," David said, grabbing Qingyi's shoulders.
"How would you like to be the Lord of the lands of Belgrath? To be a noble in more than just title?"
Qingyi thought about it for a brief moment, but in the end, he just shook his head.
"I will soon depart for the Rose Empire, and from there, I will go to the Illuminated Sky Empire. My plans don't end in the immortal heaven. Having such land here would only cause me trouble, but...
Qingyi stopped suddenly, remembering something.
Land was not of interest to him, but expanding the Burning Red Pavilion, on the other hand, most certainly was.
Meilin would probably love the idea of establishing a branch in the kingdom of Valemont, right?
Especially considering how little power her father had on this continent; even the entire Five-Colored Pavilion had only a single branch in the capital of the Rose Empire.
Other than that, this was a land of unknown riches, one that he was
sure Meilin would put to good use.

"I have no interest in land, but a business license, on the other hand, would be of interest to me. I have a chamber of commerce with one of my wives, and having the right to expand here would be very good for
us."
"Oh... Of course, that won't be a problem, hahaha," David laughed.
Honestly, even if Qingyi accepted all of Belgrath's land, David would still owe him. Not to mention something as small as a business license.
David was about to say something else when he remembered something.
"Son-in-law, I am aware that in your land, it is normal for a man to have many wives, but before your marriage to Isabel, I need to know.
How many exactly do you have?"
The moment he heard that question, Qingyi froze, which only increased David's anxiety even more.
"Ten?"
"Um... A little more..." Qingyi smiled awkwardly.
"Twenty? No... Thirty?" David's eyes widened.
He didn't want to judge Qingyi, but how on earth could anyone handle so many women?
"A little over thirty, hahahaha." Qingyi laughed at David's expression.
In the end, they just exchanged glances one last time before David sighed in defeat and let Qingyi go.
The handsome young man naturally didn't think much of it, going to his room where Isabel was sleeping peacefully.
He took off his clothes, climbed into bed, and kissed her before letting his face rest against her huge, chocolaty tits.
"Nghnn~~ Hubby's back already? Hehhee~~ I missed you so much..."
Isabel spoke, her voice cute and groggy as her beautiful emerald eyes
opened.
"Me too, love..." Qingyi sighed.
His hands rose to Isabel's breasts, massaging them gently, feeling his
fingers sink into the vast, soft flesh.
After giving her a little more love, he just entered the Mind World,
going straight to a beauty with voluptuous curves, blue eyes, and
golden hair.
She was locked in her room and immersed in magical research.
Qingyi, as always, did not ask for permission to enter, entering Margareth's room and immediately pulling her out of her chair.
"Aghhnnn~~ Hubby! I'm researching..." Margareth said, a sweet moan escaping her lips as Qingyi's palm met her perfect, round ass, sending shockwaves through her voluptuous flesh.
Qingyi's free hand went to Margareth's breasts, and then he pulled
her onto his lap.
"Your research can wait, your husband wants to know something,"
Qingyi said, taking out the talisman he had taken from that orc.
The moment she saw that talisman, Margareth's eyes widened, her heart racing.
"That... Where the hell did you get that?" Margareth asked, still unable to believe her own eyes.
"Uh? Do you know what it is?" Qingyi asked, curious.
"Yes! There isn't a single follower of Auranys who doesn't know! This
is one of the most divine artifacts of the Auranys church, gathered only by the heroes of an era!
Four have already been gathered, one by Lucien and the others by three other heroines. This must be the last one... How is this
possible?"
Qingyi heard those words, a soft smile spreading across his lips.
Heroes of a era, huh? Were they like the hero parties in the old RPGs
he used to play on Earth?
"That means I'm one of the heroes, right? Are these three heroines beauties?" Qingyi asked, laughing mischievously.
"Of course, especially the elven princess! I saw her from afar once
and..."
Suddenly, Margareth fell silent.
Her eyes filled with suspicion as she stared at her husband's face. "What are you planning, huh? You shameless womanizer!"

Qingyi, as always, did not ask for permission to enter, entering Margareth's room and immediately pulling her out of her chair.
"Aghhnnn~~ Hubby!
I'm researching..." Margareth said, a sweet moan escaping her lips as Qingyi's palm met her perfect, round ass, sending shockwaves through her voluptuous flesh.
Qingyi's free hand went to Margareth's breasts, and then he pulled
her onto his lap.
"Your research can wait, your husband wants to know something,"
Qingyi said, taking out the talisman he had taken from that orc.
The moment she saw that talisman, Margareth's eyes widened, her heart racing.
"That...
Where the hell did you get that?" Margareth asked, still unable to believe her own eyes.
"Uh?
Do you know what it is?" Qingyi asked, curious.
"Yes!
There isn't a single follower of Auranys who doesn't know!
This
is one of the most divine artifacts of the Auranys church, gathered only by the heroes of an era!
Four have already been gathered, one by Lucien and the others by three other heroines.
This must be the last one...
How is this
possible?"
Qingyi heard those words, a soft smile spreading across his lips.
Heroes of a era, huh?
Were they like the hero parties in the old RPGs
he used to play on Earth?
"That means I'm one of the heroes, right?
Are these three heroines beauties?" Qingyi asked, laughing mischievously.
"Of course, especially the elven princess!
I saw her from afar once
and..."
Suddenly, Margareth fell silent.
Her eyes filled with suspicion as she stared at her husband's face.
"What are you planning, huh?
You shameless womanizer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 419 Did you like your husband's gift?
paragraphs: A few weeks after Belgrath's death and the recapture of the great fortress in the north, the kingdom finally began to stabilize.
Soon, the wedding date between Qingyi and Isabel was set.
Naturally, such an announcement brought much celebration to the entire capital, but that was not what Qingyi was concerned with at the moment.
Above one of the largest and most prosperous port cities in the entire kingdom of Valemont, Qingyi's figure floated subtly, his purple eyes sweeping over the city below him.
At his side was Meilin, her beautiful dark eyes shining as her elegant, noble face was filled with interest.
"What do you think of this place?" Qingyi asked, wrapping his hands around her delicate waist and moving down slightly, giving her perfect, plump bubble-butt a hard slap.
"Nghnn~~ it's good... Meilin replied, blushing softly. "If we can connect it to the central pavilion in Eagle Peak Valley and start flowing eastern goods here and western goods there..."
Just thinking about it was enough to make Meilin salivate.
There was simply no supply of imported goods from the western continent to the eastern one, nor vice versa, at least not outside the capitals of the great empires that ruled each continent.
The elite of both lands would surely spend fortunes to get their hands on such exotic items.
If she could expand further into the kingdom of Valemont, she would likely have enough products to supply entire nations on the eastern continent.
Seeing the expression that took over Meilin's face, Qingyi couldn't help but laugh slightly. "Did you like your husband's gift?!"
"Yes, hubby is the best!" Meilin exclaimed, throwing herself into Qingyi's arms and kissing him.
Honestly, she had never thought much about it, but she could already imagine the faces of her other siblings when she visited her father with Qingyi.
They would probably be dying of envy, especially of the gifts she would receive from her father for such an achievement.
He was the kind of man who loved to reward his children's competence.
Pushing that thought out of her mind, she focused her eyes. "Can we take a look at the territory ceded by His Majesty David Valemont now?"
"Yes." Qingyi nodded and, with a smooth movement, flew toward the city's pier area, landing next to one of the few empty lots in that area.
It was large, with just over twenty thousand square meters of free space, more than enough for the establishment of a commercial building for a large chamber of commerce.
Naturally, such land would cost a fortune, but Qingyi received it as a gift from the royal family, just as he received the full funds for the construction of the pavilion itself and for hiring staff.
Despite this, on this last point, Meilin preferred to bring people from the eastern continent.

Of course, she needed employees from this continent as well, but in the end, she would not be here to micromanage operations and needed to bring some of her trusted subordinates to run everything there.
Exchanging glances, Qingyi and Meilin prepared to leave when a distant voice interrupted them.
Their arrival had already caused some commotion among the commoners and workers who came and went along the wide street
where the couple had landed.
Their strange clothes and transcendental beauty naturally attract attention.
This commotion only intensified when, on the horizon, a figure appeared: a middle-aged woman of ordinary and noble appearance, surrounded by soldiers in silver armor.
She was Duchess Mary, from the prosperous port city of Bluestorm,
where Qingyi and Meilin were.
"Your Highness... to what do I owe your visit to my lands?" Mary asked, bowing gently.
"You know why I am here." Qingyi smiled.
"Yes, I do, hahaha." Mary returned Qingyi's smile.
Honestly, she had a lot of admiration for this young man, especially
since her husband had been one of those who died in the fight
against Belgrath.
Knowing that he had avenged her husband certainly made her see him in a much more positive light.

"His Majesty has already contacted me, and I have arranged everything necessary to begin construction, but we would need your signature for a few things, in addition to, of course, drawing up the plans for the building," Mary said, her eyes shifting from Qingyi to
Meilin.
She didn't know that Qingyi had other wives and couldn't help but feel a little uncomfortable about it.
Qingyi was openly with another woman just a few days before his marriage to Isabel?
Both Qingyi and Meilin noticed the discomfort, but didn't pay much attention to it.
Neither of them could care less about Mary's opinion.

Shortly after this brief conversation, Qingyi and Meilin accompanied Mary to the mansion of the Lord of the city, where the daughter of the King of Gold was able to create a design for the construction of the main building of her chamber of commerce.

She had to, of course, adapt the architecture considerably to create something that the builders of this world would be capable of, while preserving part of its original appearance and, above all, its
functionality.
Under the impressed eyes of Duchess Mary, Qingyi, and other city government officials, Meilin finished quickly.
Her sketch, which took only a few minutes, was superior to what any engineer in the kingdom could do in days.
Talent was truly a miraculous thing.

After arranging everything for construction, Meilin simply used a long-range communication talisman to send a message to the main branch, giving a set of instructions to the manager so that they could finally begin to integrate the branch that would be built in Valemont.
In addition, she also needed materials and training masters to build cultivation rooms, so she needed to ensure the masters' journey to
that region.
When they finished organizing all of this, Qingyi and Meilin returned to the capital, where the handsome young man immediately locked
himself in a meditation room.
Glancing at his status screen, he smiled.
Naturally, he hadn't been idle during the few days after killing
Belgrath, and now it was time to advance to the True Immortal Realm.

Age: 21
Cultivation: Third Stage Of The False Immortal Realm
(500,000,000,000 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning: 1500 Sword: 1000 Fire: 1500 - Ice: 1500-

Spiritual roots: Immortal-level Primordial Creation Seed spirit root (Lightning, sword, fire, ice) (10T lust points to upgrade, new roots can
be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Transcendental grade,
10T lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Transcendental grade, 10T lust points to upgrade.)

chapters.title: Chapter 420 True Immortal Realm
paragraphs: Qingyi hesitated for a brief moment before finally clicking to improve
his cultivation.
[Initiating breakthrough]
The moment Qingyi received that notification, his entire body trembled. He was overcome with intense pain, his eyes widening as he gritted his teeth.
This was the final step after the False Immortal Realm, the moment when his body would finally transform into a complete vessel for a truly immortal soul.
Naturally, it was painful.
Qingyi's body rose into the air, floating a few inches above the ground, surrounded by intense light.
He kept his eyes tightly closed as his Qi flowed into his brain, rebuilding the meridians that ensured its functioning.
Above all, the energy built an invisible structure around Qingyi's mind.
It was like a second brain, but made entirely of Qi and connected directly to Qingyi's soul. A small orb of light that represented his being.
Qingyi had seen this orb many times while observing the deaths of True Immortals who tried to escape using them, but he had finally gotten his own.
That orb was his immortal mind. Even if his entire body was destroyed, as long as that orb existed, his existence and memory would be completely intact.
When the orb was finally complete, Qingyi controlled this Qi as it continued to descend through his body. The energy continued to work on his meridians, tempering and preparing them, destroying
them in order to rebuild them.
Soon, everything in Qingyi was going through the same process. Skin, muscles, and bones.
Every piece of his being was being prepared, every inch of his skin being torn apart and rebuilt.
a black goo leaked from his pores as any impurities within him were expelled.
Suddenly, Qingyi opened his eyes.
A thunderous shockwave engulfed everything around him and the meditation room shook violently, cracks spreading across the black concrete as the mana arrays struggled to keep it standing.
Even kilometers away, the most sensitive could faintly feel the tremors of this breakthrough.
[Your cultivation has been improved! Third stage of the false immortal realm -> First stage of the true immortal realm.]
"Ah..." Qingyi exhaled heavily, standing up.
A wave of steam left his lips. His clothes had been reduced to nothing, while his muscles burned with enough heat to set a piece of paper on fire just by touching it.

He could hear the chaos outside and couldn't help but sigh slightly. He really had to start being more careful with his breakthroughs. What if he accidentally ended up summoning a Heavenly Tribulation? From the Immortal Emperor Realm, something like that shouldn't be so unlikely, especially considering how outside the curve Qingyi was. Shaking his head, he just glanced at his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 21
Cultivation: First Stage Of The True Immortal Realm (5T lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning: 1500 - Sword: 1000 - Fire: 1500- Ice: 1500 - Charm: 1500 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Immortal-level Primordial Creation Seed spirit root (Lightning, sword, fire, ice) (10T lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Transcendental grade, 10T lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Transcendental grade, 10T lust points to upgrade.)
Sure, feeling poor again was a bad feeling, but Qingyi didn't think too much about it.
Just a few days with his wives and he would be rich again.
Sighing, Qingyi just stretched, used his Qi to wash his body, and then left the cultivation room.
Tomorrow would be the day he would finally marry Isabel, and now it was time for him to start preparing for it.
Naturally, the entire royal family palace was already ready for the feast, and the many royal family chefs were working tirelessly to
begin preparing the next day's meals.
The capital was buzzing with noble families and even envoys from other smaller nations interested in Qingyi.
Qingyi, unfortunately, was unable to contact Isabel during this time.
He just went alone to his room, took a long, leisurely bath, and for the rest of the night, just meditated quietly before entering the world of
the mind.
Originally, he did not plan to bring his other wives to the wedding, as he thought it would be disrespectful to Isabel, something they
themselves agreed with.
This was her special moment, and they didn't want to get in the way. One day, they would have their own special moment too.
Still, Isabel had insisted, almost begging to have all the girls at her
wedding.
In the end, they had no choice but to give in. With only a few hours to go before the wedding, Qingyi had to buy some dresses for them to
wear.
How could the girls not love that?
Soon, Qingyi found himself surrounded by hugs and kisses.
Elize was the first to throw herself into his arms, dressed in a long,
elegant white dress surrounded by golden details, pulling Qingyi into the deep valley of her massive, soft, pale tits.
Even Ruxue, who was usually too proud to have this kind of reaction to something like a dress, was happy.
Her curves were accentuated by a black dress, the pale, creamy skin of her cleavage contrasting with the fabric.

At the end of it all, Qingyi left the world of the mind with his wives and also dressed himself, wearing a traditional black and golden male wedding robe that had been carefully prepared by Meilin herself. With everyone ready, they crossed the royal palace to the wedding
venue.
It was a huge courtyard surrounded by a luxurious garden, large enough for over a thousand guests, with a white marble platform and separate seats for the groom's and bride's families.
The place was still empty, except for a few servants, David, and, of course, the priest who would perform the wedding.
The girls took the seats that would be for Qingyi's family while the handsome young man made his way to the platform.
"You're really lucky to have my daughter as your wife... I think Sofia would kill me if I brought another woman to my wedding with her, hahaha." David laughed, patting Qingyi on the shoulder.
"Hahaha, she's a good woman, and honestly, I don't deserve her, I
don't deserve any of them." Qingyi smiled, focusing his gaze on the
arriving guests.
This was his final step in the Kingdom of Valemont.
After the wedding and the organization of the Meilin Chamber of Commerce, it would be time for him to leave for the Rose Empire and take a look at this group of heroes.
The heroines of this group, to be more specific.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - Wedding (01)
paragraphs: Qingyi remained at the center of the altar beside David.
His ears were briefly filled with the excited whispers of his wives before he refocused on the guests who were arriving little by little.
Soon, David left the altar to greet people, while Qingyi sat down with his other wives.
There were still many hours to go before the ceremony actually began, so he had plenty of free time.

The venue slowly began to fill as more noble families arrived. Some cast envious glances at Qingyi. Others, such as the bishop of the capital, seemed enraged by the disrespect shown by both Qingyi and the royal family.
Not only had Qingyi sinned, but the royal family itself had completely disregarded the bishop.
They had even summoned a priest from a remote city to perform the wedding.
For the past fifty years, he had been responsible for marrying the nobles of the capital.
Who did David think he was to change that?
In the end, the bishop could only swallow his bitterness, sitting in the back and grumbling with anger.
He had only attended because being at the side of the royal family was one of his duties, assigned by his superior on the day he took the position.
Naturally, everyone ignored him.
Although they were faithful followers of Auranys, the kingdom of Valemont was on the opposite side of the continent. It was a forgotten place, far from the influence of the divine kingdom of
Auranys.
Qingyi, meanwhile, was being pampered by his wives, receiving treats in his mouth and eating leisurely.
The food wasn't as good as Elize's, but it was still pretty decent.
"I have to go now..." he said, his eyes opening slightly.
All the guests had already arrived.
He didn't really care about the judgmental looks. He just got up and walked to the large marble platform, standing face to face with the priest.
Normally, he should kneel and ask for Auranys' blessing, but he didn't.
He remained standing, his head held high proudly.
He would not kneel before anyone he did not deem worthy.
The priest was not happy about this, but what could he do?
Qingyi was a foreigner who did not follow his goddess, and he was powerful enough to crush everyone there.
There was little the priest could do against someone like that.
Qingyi just stood there, turning gently to face the guests. David came up beside him, revealing a big smile.
"Today, I am happy to announce, once again, that my little Isabel is back. But not only that. She has found a man of power and honor to call her husband.
A man who saved our family and the entire kingdom from ruin. A man who killed a powerful Orc warlord and a pig who betrayed humanity." David paused briefly.
"And for that, I am proud to marry my daughter to this man, Long Qingyi, today."
The moment David's voice fell silent, the ceremony began. Soft, gentle music began to play as the band started their work.
The large double doors, which had been firmly closed after the guests arrived, suddenly opened. From there, two figures emerged, holding hands.
One of them was Queen Sofia, calm and elegant as always. The other was Isabel.
The dark-skinned beauty was more beautiful than ever. Her curves were covered by a graceful, long white dress, and her white hair was elegantly pinned up.
A pure, thin veil fell over her face, gently covering her delicate features.

She placed her other hand in front of her belly, holding a faint bouquet of flowers in front of her waist, so thin and slender that it looked like it was about to break under the weight of her huge breasts.

Slowly, she walked toward Qingyi, climbing the altar. Finally, she let go of Sofia's hand, standing alone with Qingyi and the priest. "Hubby looks very good in those clothes... you should wear more black," Isabel whispered, her eyes scanning Qingyi's robes.
It was beautiful, noble, and elegant.

The fabric, black as night, clung to his powerful muscles, creating a protective V-shape. A long skirt fell over his pants, covered with patterns of golden dragons, each carefully handcrafted by Meilin herself; powerful and perfect.
Qingyi just smiled at those words.
He also liked those clothes, and honestly, he should have abandoned
the teachings of his former master long ago.
That old man brought him nothing but negative feelings.
Crossing his arms with Isabel's, Qingyi turned to the priest, whose face sank a little further.
Wouldn't even Isabel kneel to ask for Auranys' blessing?
What the hell was wrong with this generation of young people?
'I'll bow down to her if she's willing to become my hubby's wife, hehehe, Isabel smiled to herself.
She had already talked with Qingyi about Aurany. She knew well that the goddess did not like her husband very much and had even tried to
curse him.
She did not know how Qingyi knew these things, but she would not doubt his words.
Sighing, the priest began the ceremony.
"We are gathered here today for the union of Long Qingyi and Isabel Valemont." He pointed upward.
Behind him was a golden statue of what was supposed to be Auranys, or at least the mortal conception of her.
From his pointing finger, golden Qi flowed to the statue, causing it to be taken over by an intense glow.

"And by the power vested in me by His Holiness, the Bishop of Arca Cathedral, I bestow upon you the blessing of Auranys. May she protect you, may your life be long, and may your love be eternal," the priest said, turning to Qingyi.
"Long Qingyi, do you promise to love and protect Isabel Valemont for
eternity?

The blazing Qi of fire, the silvery Qi of the sword, the bluish-purple Qi of lightning, and the sky-blue Qi of ice.
All of them leaked out of his body at the same time, the temperature around him ranging from thousands of degrees to tens of degrees below zero.
The very stone that surrounded him seemed about to melt, the lightning tearing everything apart while the sword Qi cut deep, sharp
gashes.
If there was anything alive there, it would be immediately cut into thousands of pieces.
If the walls of that meditation room weren't several meters thick and covered by powerful mana arrays, they would have probably
collapsed already.
Qingyi just held on tightly, feeling the three new elements reach hist
body, flowing through his meridians.

spirit roots.

light.

blood.

ahead, hitting the wall with a thud, his arm gushing blood nonstop. "Shit..." Qingyi gritted his teeth, the Qi of the seed of life immediately beginning to act, healing his hand instantly.

spatial magic, and yet she could barely use a basic spell capable of transporting an apple.

and shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 Water
paragraphs: Qingyi quickly raised the affinities of all the new elements of his spiritual root to 1500. His understanding exploded, and with it, his control.
With a soft sigh, he opened his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 21
Cultivation: First Stage Of The True Immortal Realm (5T lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning: 1500 - Sword: 1000 - Fire: 1500 - Ice: 1500 - Space: 1500 - Light: 1500 - Shadow: 1500 - Charm: 1500 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Immortal-level Primordial Creation Seed spirit root (Lightning, sword, fire, ice, space, light, shadow) (10T lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Transcendental grade, 10T lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Transcendental grade, 10T lust points to upgrade.)
The list was much longer than before, but Qingyi barely paid attention to it. He just glanced briefly at his lust point balance before focusing his mind again.
Improving his affinities had cost much more than expected, and when he looked at the price of the pills needed to bring them up to level two thousand, Qingyi couldn't help but sigh in defeat.
In the end, he simply left the meditation room, chose a random direction, and flew nonstop, looking for a suitable place to start
training his new skills.

Of course, much of this training would be done in his sea of mind, where time passed much more slowly than in the outside world. However, Qingyi still wanted a free place to test this power in reality. After a few hours of searching, Qingyi finally interrupted his flight, landing in a deep valley surrounded by hills and mountains.
Spreading his Qi senses, he found that there were no humans within a radius of several kilometers.
With a smooth movement, Qingyi landed, immediately assuming a cross-legged position.
He entered his sea of mind, feeling the usual pleasant sensation of that warm, shallow water at his feet.
He also felt the warmth of his own Dantian, now taken over by three other types of Qi.
Qingyi wanted to train them all, but for now, he forced himself to focus only on spatial Qi.
He didn't want to end up being torn apart by this energy when trying to use it in battle and being unable to control it efficiently.
Qingyi closed his eyes, calming his mind. He felt his long black hair flutter in the fake but pleasant breeze of that endless water world.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes, calling upon his spatial Qi and pointing it toward the water.

His vision distorted, and all the water in the place he pointed at was swallowed up. However, before it could even be sent elsewhere, Qingyi's Qi collapsed again, causing the water to explode in violent
waves.
"Shit..." He grunted, trying again.
This time, he was a little more successful; a single drop of water, small and tenuous, was able to pass through the spatial distortion before collapsing.
Qingyi sighed in disappointment, but he did not lose heart,
continuing to train.
After all, he still had many days of training there before anyone would even notice his absence.
During the first day, Qingyi focused only on water. He quickly increased the amount of liquid he could transport and the time he could keep the spatial distortion open.
Honestly, it was a hellish process.
He was only able to use that ability efficiently by keeping his draconic
mind active, correcting any minor spatial flaws.
Still, Qingyi couldn't help but get more and more excited with each new breakthrough. Soon, he was able to keep those portals open for long seconds.
Then, he stopped moving only water. He also started testing with spears and swords, throwing them and using his spatial Qi to change their places and trajectories, creating unique and unpredictable
patterns.
Only after a week of training was Qingyi finally able to send his entire body through one of these spatial folds.
It was similar to teleportation talismans, but here he had complete control over everything.
His body was swallowed by a deep darkness, taken to an unknown plane, and then reappeared at the chosen location.
Unable to suppress his excitement, Qingyi devoted the last twelve days to training his overall combat strength and efficiently combining
all those elements.
And so, after nineteen days of training, Qingyi finally left the sea of
the mind.
He was immediately greeted by the gentle midday breeze and the weight of birds perched on his body.
Qingyi did not scare them away immediately. He rose lightly, giving them time to fly away before drawing the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
He chose a point in the emptiness and used the fourth form of the Stormy Monarch Sword Art.
This time, he did not call forth thousands of swords.
He created only ten ethereal, thunderous blades, which flew slowly around him, imbued with a Qi powerful enough to injure even True Immortals.
Qingyi took a single moment to prepare before moving toward that point in the void.

The ten blades followed him, tearing through the air at an absurd speed before being completely swallowed by Qingyi's shadow Qi. The beautiful young man smiled, changed the trajectory of his blades, and then moved his spatial Qi.
His body was swallowed by an endless black hole, the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword already cutting through the air as he reappeared a few dozen meters above the forest, attacking downward.
A slash of sword Qi, flames, and lightning enveloped the sharp blade. The air around him boiled as the strike opened like a crescent moon, swallowing the world around it.
At that moment, seconds before the attack hit the ground, he used
his spatial Qi again.
His body vanished with a shockwave. Space distorted at the exact point where the ten thunderous ethereal swords and his final attack
converged.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword became nothing more than a luminous blur as Qingyi parried all eleven attacks in a single fraction
of a second.
The shockwaves from the eleven impacts spread out around him,

uprooting trees and turning the ground beneath his feet to dust, sweeping away everything for over a kilometer. "Incredible..." Qingyi murmured, flashing a broad, satisfied smile. Such speed... such malleability... it was as if he were water.
